items.hed: Texans list this Sunday as a bye, with the next game Nov. 8 at the Chargers
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Nov. 1, as a bye week, with no kickoff and no score. The Oct. 25 home game against the New York Giants at Reliant Stadium is still marked upcoming, with the score field empty, so none is printed here. Next game listed is Nov. 8 at the Los Angeles Chargers, 3:05 p.m. CT, on CBS, at SoFi Stadium.
